user.title: Hive Local TRV
user.description:
Enter your Zigbee2MQTT base topic. TRVs are discovered automatically.

Use **Configure** afterwards to add a boiler entity or geofencing.

data_description.z2m_base_topic: Matches base_topic in your Zigbee2MQTT config. Default: zigbee2mqtt

abort.already_configured: This Zigbee2MQTT instance is already configured.

init.title: Configure Hive Local TRV
init.description: Optionally add a boiler entity and geofencing persons.

data_description.boiler_entity: Turned on/off based on TRV heat demand. Supports climate, switch, input_boolean.
data_description.person_entities: When all leave home, frost protection activates automatically.
